data.name: Ayanman
data.gender_notes: Ayanman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayanman is a Sanskrit name derived from the roots 'Ayam' (lord) and 'Manas' (mind or cosmos). This name signifies the supreme lord of the cosmos, who is the ruler of both the physical and the mental realms. It is believed that Ayanman is the embodiment of wisdom, power, and consciousness. The name Ayanman carries the meaning “Lord of the Cosmos” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayanman usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the cosmos and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of cosmic consciousness and divine wisdom
data.etymology: Ayanman belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Cosmos.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayanman total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ayanman is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, symbolizing the divine ruler of the universe. It reflects the Hindu philosophical belief in the supreme power and consciousness that governs all beings and things. The name carries a rich legacy, evoking a sense of reverence and respect for the divine power that shapes our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond the cultural significance, the name Ayanman holds deep spiritual significance for Hindus. It symbolizes the ultimate reality and consciousness that lies at the heart of all creation. The name represents the divine wisdom and power that guides and sustains the universe, inspiring seekers to connect with their inner selves and the cosmic consciousness. It reminds us of our innate connection to the divine and encourages us to live in alignment with the highest principles of truth, love, and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ayanman symbolizes the eternal seeker, constantly evolving towards self-realization. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ayan' (the wanderer) and 'Man' (mind), representing the journey of the soul in search of wisdom and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Ayanman is mentioned in the 'Aitareya Aranyaka' of the Rigveda, one of the oldest Hindu scriptures, as a god of the Vedic pantheon. The Aranyaka is believed to have been composed between 900-500 BCE.

The Puranic texts, written between 400-1200 CE, describe Ayanman as the creator of the universe and the lord of the directions. He is often depicted as a form of the god Shiva, with multiple arms and heads.
historical_references.context: Creator of the universe, lord of the directions, form of Shiva

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ayanman' has gained popularity in modern contexts, especially within the realms of astrology, spirituality, and personalized solutions. On Instagram, numerous astrologers and spiritual influencers have adopted the name Ayanman, using it as a handle for their accounts where they provide daily horoscopes, astrological insights, and spiritual guidance to their followers. Additionally, websites such as MindBodyGreen and AstroSage feature articles and consultations by astrologers and spiritual advisors named Ayanman, providing a platform for those seeking personalized and in-depth insights. The name Ayanman thus symbolizes an individual deeply rooted in astrological and spiritual practices, offering guidance and solutions tailored to the unique needs and queries of their clients.
